assembly.alpha: frozen clamp matte restricted to 6 px mask dilation; no depth fade
assembly.seam_cost: mean absolute straight RGB, 0..255, only both present; zero elsewhere
assembly.dynamic_programming: global minimum accumulated cost with step -1/0/+1; free endpoints
assembly.feather: linear +/-3 px in seam transverse coordinate; premultiplied interpolation
assembly.corners: evaluate horizontal and vertical paths; choose lower mean including zero-cost void; intersecting overlap candidates choose lower path mean
assembly.seam_stats_against: existing assembled canvas versus incoming chunk; geometric chunk pair and actual contributors recorded

noise.method: cubic interpolated value-noise lattices; combined field min/max normalized to [0,1]

band.void_F: nearest FACE directly above <=400 px; clip((100+160*N-g)/40,-2,2), else -2

c_band_onset_depth_mm.definition: depth at first FACE pixel from top with cloud alpha >=0.5

d_void_extent_px.definition: farthest qualifying VOID pixel below last FACE in column, maximum search 400 px; absent extent=0
